samples.summary: Anonymous share-link insert still fails: the dimension probe fetches the un-tokened workspace image URL, so acceptance criterion 1 ("an anonymous editor-role visitor can insert an image") is not met.
samples.evidence: `insertImageFromFile` does `const url = await upload(file); const { width, height } = await loadImageDimensions(url);`. For the share path `url` is `resolveImageUrl("/api/v1/workspaces/<wid>/images/<id>")` with **no** `?token=` (deliberate — the URL is stored in the CRDT). `loadImageDimensions` then loads that URL in a bare `new Image()` (image-insert.ts:67-82). The read route `ApiV1ImageReadController.assertCanRead` (packages/backend/src/api/v1/image-read.controller.ts:92-134) requires an API key, a member JWT, or a matching `?token=`; an anonymous visitor has none of these, so the request 403s, `img.onerror` fires, the promise rejects, and the catch in `insertImageFromFile` shows "Image upload failed" and inserts nothing. The docs engine resolver added in this change (`setImageUrlResolver` in packages/docs/src/view/image-cache.ts) only affects `getOrLoadImage`, not this frontend-side probe — so the bytes are uploaded but the image never lands in the document. The probe needs the tokened URL (e.g. `appendShareTokenToImageUrl`) while the stored `src` stays un-tokened.

samples.summary: The canonical /api/v1 route inventory (`docs/design/rest-api.md`) is not updated and is now factually wrong about the new controller.
samples.evidence: §5.6 "Images (workspace-scoped blobs)" lists only the three `/api/v1/workspaces/:wid/images` routes and does not mention the new `POST /api/v1/shared/images?token=`; §6's module tree omits `image-share-upload.controller.ts`; and rest-api.md:549 asserts "Every v1 controller mounts the guard except `ApiV1ImageReadController`, which also serves anonymous share-token viewers and so cannot" — `ApiV1ShareImageUploadController` is now a second v1 controller with no `WorkspaceScopeGuard`, so that sentence is stale. The change documents the feature only in docs/design/sharing.md, leaving the route/guard inventory doc contradicting the code.
searchedFor: read docs/design/rest-api.md §5.6 (lines 430-500) and the guard paragraph (lines 535-560) and §6 module tree

samples.summary: Fourth hand-rolled copy of the `setImageUrlResolver` seam rather than factoring it into `@wafflebase/core/image`, where the shared `loadImage` this cache already imports lives.
samples.evidence: packages/docs/src/view/image-cache.ts:20-44 adds a module-level `urlResolver` + `setImageUrlResolver` whose own comment says it "Mirrors the same seam in slides (`view/canvas/image-cache.ts`), notes (`view/preview.ts`) and sheets (`spreadsheet/image-cache.ts`)". `packages/core/src/image/index.ts` is the existing home for exactly this kind of engine-agnostic image configuration (`setCredentialedImageOrigins`, whose doc comment even says it "Mirrors the `setImageUrlResolver` seam the caches already expose"), and docs' cache already imports `loadImage` from it. Following the existing per-engine precedent is defensible, but the resolver contract (idempotent, leave `data:`/`blob:`/foreign URLs alone) is now duplicated in four places and can drift.

samples.summary: `failureText` is unrequested scope: it changes the error message of every image upload in the module, not just the share-token path.
samples.evidence: The new `failureText` helper unwraps Nest's JSON `{message,statusCode}` for all callers of the private `post()` — `postWorkspaceImage`, `postSharedImage` and `postShareTokenImage` alike. It is a reasonable improvement and is needed for the share-path toast, but it is not in the issue's acceptance list (docs/tasks/active/20260907-share-link-image-upload-todo.md) and silently alters existing owner-path error strings.

finding.summary: Anonymous share-link insert still fails: the dimension probe fetches the un-tokened workspace image URL, so acceptance criterion 1 ("an anonymous editor-role visitor can insert an image") is not met.
finding.evidence: `insertImageFromFile` does `const url = await upload(file); const { width, height } = await loadImageDimensions(url);`. For the share path `url` is `resolveImageUrl("/api/v1/workspaces/<wid>/images/<id>")` with **no** `?token=` (deliberate — the URL is stored in the CRDT). `loadImageDimensions` then loads that URL in a bare `new Image()` (image-insert.ts:67-82). The read route `ApiV1ImageReadController.assertCanRead` (packages/backend/src/api/v1/image-read.controller.ts:92-134) requires an API key, a member JWT, or a matching `?token=`; an anonymous visitor has none of these, so the request 403s, `img.onerror` fires, the promise rejects, and the catch in `insertImageFromFile` shows "Image upload failed" and inserts nothing. The docs engine resolver added in this change (`setImageUrlResolver` in packages/docs/src/view/image-cache.ts) only affects `getOrLoadImage`, not this frontend-side probe — so the bytes are uploaded but the image never lands in the document. The probe needs the tokened URL (e.g. `appendShareTokenToImageUrl`) while the stored `src` stays un-tokened.

verdict.reason: The code is exactly as described. `insertImageFromFile` (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/image-insert.ts:100-101) probes dimensions via `loadImageDimensions(url)`, which loads the URL in a bare `new Image()` (image-insert.ts:67-82) with no token and no resolver. On the anonymous share path, `url` comes from `shareTokenImageUploader` (image-insert.ts:40-49) → `resolveImageUrl` of the backend's deliberately un-tokened `/api/v1/workspaces/<wid>/images/<id>` (image-share-upload.controller.ts:107-115; export-utils.ts:12-18 adds only the origin prefix). That read route requires an API key, member JWT, or matching `?token=` and otherwise throws ForbiddenException (image-read.controller.ts:92-134), which an anonymous visitor cannot satisfy, so the probe rejects and the catch (image-insert.ts:109-116) toasts and inserts nothing. The new docs `setImageUrlResolver` seam is applied only inside `getOrLoadImage` (packages/docs/src/view/image-cache.ts:40-57), i.e. canvas render time, so it does not cover this frontend probe. `SharedDocsLayout` really routes the anonymous editor through this path (packages/frontend/src/app/shared/shared-document.tsx:331-334, 360, 367). This leaves acceptance criterion 1 ("An anonymous editor-role share-link visitor can insert an image into a shared Docs document", docs/tasks/active/20260907-share-link-image-upload-todo.md:11-12) unmet — a user-facing outcome the change claims to deliver, which is `major` under the design-fit rubric. No refutation ground applies.
